We are working towards something big, together. We foster a culture built on five core values: Generosity First, Always: We lead with kindness. Our best work happens when we act in service of others. Constant Curiosity: We are eager to learn, grow, and explore beyond the obvious. Act with Agility: We welcome change; it’s the only constant. We embrace, adjust, adapt. Passion for Positivity: We greet each day with warmth and possibility. Collective Ambition: We have high aspirations that are achieved when we work together with a shared purpose. Team Member Relations Partner The Team Member Relations Partner supports the Team Member Relations function by promoting a positive, respectful, and compliant workplace environment across CAVA’s restaurant teams. This role partners closely with People + Culture Business Partners, Operations leaders, and team members to address workplace concerns, support investigations, provide guidance on company policies, and help ensure consistent application of employment practices. The Team Member Relations Partner serves as a trusted resource for team members and leaders while helping foster an inclusive culture aligned with CAVA’s values. This position requires strong judgment, professionalism, and the ability to manage sensitive situations with confidentiality and care. This job description is not intended to be a comprehensive list of all duties and responsibilities of the position, and such duties and responsibilities may change without notice. Success at CAVA: At CAVA, Team Member Relations Parnters are proactive problem-solvers who build strong relationships, deliver excellent service, and contribute to a positive team member experience. We look for individuals who demonstrate sound judgment, communicate effectively, embrace learning, and support a culture of fairness, accountability, and belonging. What You'll Do: Serve as a first point of contact for team member relations concerns and workplace issues. Conduct intake conversations and support investigations involving policy violations, workplace conflicts, performance concerns, and other employee relations matters. Document investigations, findings, and recommendations in a thorough, timely, and objective manner. Partner with People + Culture Business Partners and Operations leaders to resolve team member concerns and support appropriate corrective actions. Provide guidance to leaders on company policies, procedures, and best practices for team member management. Support the administration and tracking of team member relations cases through case management systems and reporting tools. Monitor trends in team member relations data and identify opportunities for proactive interventions and process improvements. Assist in developing and delivering training related to workplace conduct, respectful workplace expectations, and company policies. Support compliance with federal, state, and local employment laws and company policies. Collaborate with cross-functional partners, including Legal, Payroll, Learning + Development, and HRIS, as needed to support team member relations initiatives. Maintain confidentiality and exercise sound judgment when handling sensitive information. Contribute to projects and initiatives that enhance the overall team member experience and strengthen workplace culture. Qualifications: Education & Experience 2–3 years of experience in Human Resources, Employee Relations, Labor Relations, or a related field, preferably in the restaurant or hospitality industry. Experience supporting workplace investigations, conflict resolution, or employee relations matters preferred. Working knowledge of employment laws and HR best practices. Strong interpersonal and communication skills with the ability to build trust and credibility at all levels of the organization. Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail. Strong critical thinking, problem-solving, and decision-making capabilities. Ability to handle confidential information with professionalism and discretion. Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and HR systems. Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Psychology, Communications, or a related field preferred. Physical Requirements: Ability to maintain stationary position to be able to operate a computer and other office equipment Must be able to identify, analyze and assess details For certain positions, must be able to occasionally move or transport items up to 50 pounds Ability to communicate with others and exchange information accurately and effectively Constantly positions self and move about to support ordinary restaurant or food production support or office operations, as applicable Ability to work in a constant state of alertness and in a safe manner What we offer: Competitive salary, plus bonus and long-term incentives* Early Wage Access! Unlimited PTO, paid parental leave, plus paid opportunities to give back to the community Health, Dental, Vision, Telemedicine, Pet Insurance plus more! 401k enrollment with CAVA contribution Company-paid STD, LTD, Life and AD&D coverage for salaried positions* Free CAVA food Casual work environment The opportunity to be on the ground floor of a rapidly growing brand All exempt and non exempt employees are eligible for benefits. Benefits are effective the 1st of the month following 30 days of service and you have until the day before the effective date to enroll. A new hire can enroll in our benefit program by selecting a link that is emailed directly to the new hire at their personal email address once hired. Please note that visa sponsorship is not available. The posting range is an all cash range. *Indicates qualifying eligible positions only. paragraphs: I am writing to apply for the Team Member Relations Partner position within CAVA's team. The opportunity to work across international contract law, IP, and privacy law at a globally recognised company is exactly the kind of environment I have been working towards – and I am confident my background makes me a strong fit.

I hold an LL.M. in Business and Corporate Law (First Rank, Symbiosis International University) and have practical experience drafting and negotiating commercial contracts in a corporate legal practice. At Poise Legal in India, I managed the full lifecycle of 5-7 commercial agreements per month – NDAs, service agreements, and supply contracts – while conducting regulatory and company law research to support corporate clients. More recently, I completed a professional language placement at Asianajajatoimisto Regelin Oy in Oulu, where I worked directly within a Finnish law firm environment, developing my Finnish legal vocabulary and observing local legal processes first-hand.

I am currently pursuing Finnish supplementary law studies at the University of Lapland (OPH-recognised), which directly reflects my commitment to integrating my international legal expertise with the Finnish legal system. I work comfortably and independently in both English and Finnish, and I approach both complex legal analysis and routine administrative tasks with the same attention to detail and proactive attitude.

CAVA's in-house model – working directly alongside the General Counsel and gaining exposure to corporate-level legal operations – is precisely the learning environment I am seeking. I am available for the September 2026 start and can commit to the part-time schedule during the academic year, transitioning to full-time over summer.
I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how I can contribute to your team.
